name: Premium Nethili Shutki
description: Premium sun-dried anchovies with a deep coastal aroma.
long_description: Premium sun-dried anchovies with a deep coastal aroma. Each batch of Premium Nethili Shutki is traditionally sun-dried along the coast and hygienically cleaned, graded and packed to preserve its distinctive flavour. A versatile ingredient for authentic coastal curries, fries and chutneys.
storage_instructions: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening for longer freshness. Keep away from direct sunlight and moisture.
preparation_instructions: Rinse thoroughly in warm water before cooking. Soak for 10–15 minutes if preferred. Cook as per your favourite coastal recipe.
